en.headline: M+ opens Herzog & de Meuron: In Focus for museum’s fifth anniversary
en.dek: The exhibition in the Focus Gallery displays newly donated models, drawings and material samples from the Swiss firm that designed the M+ building, Tai Kwun and Beijing’s National Stadium, running from 12 September 2026.
body: M+ has opened Herzog & de Meuron: In Focus in its Focus Gallery on Level 2 to mark the museum’s fifth anniversary. The presentation centres on a second significant donation of archival material from the Swiss architecture firm that designed the M+ building itself.

The exhibition features models, drawings, material samples and prototypes relating to ten projects in China between 2002 and 2021. These include the M+ museum (2012–2021), Tai Kwun in Hong Kong (2006–2018) and the National Stadium in Beijing (2002–2008), commonly known as the Bird’s Nest, as well as selected urban planning work.

Objects are displayed in exact replicas of the wooden vitrines used in the firm’s Kabinett open-storage archive in Basel. The format is intended to give visitors a closer view of the design process. The exhibition opened to the public on 12 September 2026 and is scheduled to continue until 10 January 2027. Standard M+ admission applies; the museum is closed on Mondays.

zh.headline: M+呈獻Herzog & de Meuron聚焦展 慶祝開幕五周年
zh.dek: 焦點空間展出瑞士建築事務所新近捐贈的模型、繪圖及物料樣本，涵蓋M+大樓、大館及北京國家體育場等項目，2026年9月12日起開放。
body: 西九文化區M+博物館於二樓焦點空間開展《Herzog & de Meuron：聚焦》，以慶祝博物館開幕五周年。展覽圍繞該瑞士建築事務所向M+作出的第二批重要檔案捐贈，事務所本身正是M+大樓的設計者。
展品包括模型、繪圖、物料樣本及原型，展示事務所2002至2021年間在中國的十個項目，當中包括M+博物館（2012–2021）、香港大館（2006–2018）及北京國家體育場（2002–2008，俗稱「鳥巢」），以及部分城市規劃工作。
展品置於仿照事務所位於巴塞爾Kabinett開放式貯藏室的木造展示櫃內，讓觀眾近距離了解設計過程。展覽於2026年9月12日對外開放，預定展至2027年1月10日。觀眾須購買M+標準門票，逢星期一休館。
